display.purpose: Race names on fields and the public board. font-stretch 68%.

numeral.purpose: Bibs, positions, clocks and times. font-stretch 68%, tabular figures.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The yellow flash on a new time and the athlete card rising; both off under reduced motion.

components.name: Bib chip
components.description: An athlete, anywhere in the app. Opens their card.
components.css: .ds-bib { display: inline-grid; min-width: 4.25rem; padding: 0; background: #fff; color: #0B0B0C; border: 2px solid #0B0B0C; text-align: center; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bib i { height: 8px; background: #1447E6; } .ds-bib b { padding: 0 6px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 68%; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-bib:hover { background: #FFD60A; }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one action to take on a screen.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #FFD60A; color: #0B0B0C; border: 2px solid #0B0B0C; border-radius: 0; font: 600 1rem Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:active { background: #0B0B0C; color: #FFD60A; }

components.name: Race field
components.description: A race in its own colour: name, clock, counts.
components.css: .ds-field { padding: 18px 20px; background: #1447E6; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 68%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field b { display: block; font-size: 4.5rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: .9; } .ds-field span { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: TrailTime looks like the thing a race official already reads all day: the race bib. Every athlete is a white tile with heavy black numerals and a band in their race's colour. Each race owns one flat colour across the app, and hi-vis yellow is reserved for the one thing to press and for what needs a look.

rules.name: The bib rule
rules.body: Any athlete shown anywhere is a bib chip, and the chip opens their card.

rules.name: One colour per race
rules.body: Race colour appears only on that race's field, band or bar.

rules.name: Yellow means act
rules.body: If it is yellow, it can be pressed or it needs someone.

dos: Show an athlete as their bib chip
Keep a race in its own colour on every screen
Pair every colour signal with words
donts: Use race colours or yellow for decoration
Add shadows, gradients or rounded cards
Recolour the bib in dark mode
